description: Performance ads. Revokes a credential at once: events signed with it are refused from then on. It cannot be undone.

api_key.description: The API key of the account (can_live_...). Optional when this MCP connection sends it as the Authorization: Bearer header.

credential_id.description: The id of an event-signing credential (crd_...), from create_event_credential or list_event_credentials.

name: revoke_event_credential
title: Revoke an event-signing credential
